title: Search In Rotated Sorted Array
description: There is an integer array nums sorted in ascending order (with distinct values), which is possibly rotated at an unknown pivot. Given the array after rotation and an integer target, return the index of target if it is in the array, or -1 if it is not. You must write an algorithm with O(log n) runtime complexity.

interfaces.signature: def search(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
